955-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
955-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

539-1462-3821-3899-4679.description:

When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.

710-997-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-997-8207.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

323-1339-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-1339-1832-2034.description:

The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

728-3249-4289-6887--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-997--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

628-4247-7195.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Damage Control Crew.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from exile to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5220-5708-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1849-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

3490-4369-5231-6235.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-5231-6235.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Agate Instigator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2404-6507-6763-7115.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
2404-6507-6763-7115.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
2404-6507-6763-7115.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
2404-6507-6763-7115.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1117-3375-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.

When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.

Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1174-1479-2374.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.

Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate a Strionic Resonator copy by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 6.
